chunks.text: The retention policy keeps standard records for ninety days.
Priority one incidents require acknowledgement within fifteen minutes.
Refund requests are accepted within thirty days of purchase.
Backups are retained in glacier storage for one year.
General support requests are answered within two business days.
The service catalog describes response targets and escalation paths.
A marketing campaign may run for ninety days before review.
Purchases can be returned after inspection by the finance team.
